name: Festa Booking
query:
SELECT
    b.name AS "Booking ID:Link/Festa Booking:120",
    b.event AS "Event:Link/Festa Event:150",
    b.user AS "Customer:Link/User:150",
    b.payment_status AS "Payment Status:Data:120",
    ROUND(b.total_amount, 2) AS "Total Amount:Currency:120",
    b.currency AS "Currency:Data:80",
    b.qr_code_url AS "QR Code:Data:200",
    b.creation AS "Booking Date:Datetime:150",
    GROUP_CONCAT(a.full_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Attendees:Data:250"
FROM
    `tabFesta Booking` b
LEFT JOIN
    `tabFesta Attende Booking` a 
    ON a.parent = b.name
WHERE
    (%(event)s IS NULL OR %(event)s = '' OR b.event = %(event)s)
    AND (%(payment_status)s IS NULL OR %(payment_status)s = '' OR b.payment_status = %(payment_status)s)
    AND (%(user)s IS NULL OR %(user)s = '' OR b.user = %(user)s)
    AND (%(creation_from)s IS NULL OR %(creation_from)s = '' OR DATE(b.creation) >= %(creation_from)s)
    AND (%(creation_to)s IS NULL OR %(creation_to)s = '' OR DATE(b.creation) <= %(creation_to)s)
GROUP BY
    b.name, b.event, b.user, b.payment_status, b.total_amount, b.currency, b.qr_code_url, b.creation
ORDER BY
    b.creation DESC;
